note: 2026-11-28: Florida visit info refreshed. Hours, prices and rules as each operator publishes them, cross-read against the Florida research sheet of the same date. Where the operator posts nothing current the field is empty, never filled from an old page.

places.hours: Saturday and Sunday 9 am–3 pm. Closed Monday to Friday on the regular schedule; some weekday sessions are added on the ticket calendar.
places.how: Practice tickets are sold online. The track asks riders to check ticket availability before driving out.
rules: Main, intermediate and kids tracks
places.source_title: MX 191: the track's own ticket page

places.hours: Wednesday to Sunday 8 am–4 pm. Closed Monday and Tuesday.
rules: Two full-size tracks and a separate peewee track
Pit speed limit 5 mph, first gear only
Pit bike riders must wear a helmet
No pit bike riding after dark
places.source_title: Moto Bros Okeechobee MX: the track's own website

places.hours: Wednesday and Thursday 2–10 pm under the lights. Friday 9 am–4 pm. Saturday and Sunday 8 am–4 pm.
rules: Separate pit bike track
Current rider price is not posted on the track page: call or check before you go
places.source_title: MotoBros Punta Gorda MX: the track's own website

places.hours: Thursday 9 am–2 pm. Saturday 8 am–4 pm and Sunday 8 am–6 pm: minis from 8, beginner, novice and vet novice from 9, advanced from 10. Closed Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday and Friday.
places.day: Main track $40 a day for Florida, Georgia and South Carolina residents. Kids on minis on the peewee track $35. PW50 $30. The price for riders from other states is not posted.
rules: Separate mini and peewee track
places.source_title: North Florida Motocross Park: the track's own website

places.hours: Open practice 10 am–4 pm on scheduled days only; the track posts each month's dates. Closed November 27–29, 2026 for track upgrades.
places.how: Membership is optional. Sign the waiver before riding.
rules: Full-size track plus pit bike, intermediate and turn tracks and a woods loop
72 RV sites, 24 with full hookups
places.source_title: Waldo MX & Event Grounds: the track's own website

places.hours: Saturday and Sunday 10 am–4 pm; Wednesday and Thursday 10 am to dark.
rules: Motocross helmet and boots, long sleeves and long pants required
places.source_title: Orlando MX Park: the track's own website

places.hours: January to April: organized public practice on Saturdays only; gates 7 am, registration 9 am. November and December ride dates are announced by email.
places.day: Public practice $50 per rider; $40 for Florida and Georgia residents; $35 each for a family of four or more; $30 military; mini track $25. Arriving after 12:30 pm: $40 instead of $50.
places.how: Sign up at the red barn window, sign the waivers and wear the wristband.
rules: Main track is dirt bikes only; minis and youth electric bikes use the mini track
Helmet and boots required on the mini track
A minor with a guardian who is not a parent needs a notarized letter
No section work or track cutting during public practice
Check the track's social pages for weather changes before the weekend
places.source_title: Sunshine State MX Park: the track's own website

places.hours: Saturday night racing: gates 2 pm, practice 3 pm, racing 5 pm. Saturdays with no race: practice 5–9 pm. Thursday night practice: 50cc 4–6 pm, all other classes 6–10 pm. Sunday day practice on the extended track 9 am–2 pm on calendar dates. MX school Saturdays 9 am–12:30 pm.
places.day: Gate $15 for riders and spectators. Practice $20 (Sunday extended track $30). Race entry $30 a class. Saturday MX school $40 with no gate fee.
rules: Helmet, boots, goggles and chest protector required
Under 5 free at the gate if not racing
No membership needed for the Saturday school
places.source_title: Dade City Motocross: the track's own website

places.hours: Open on select days only: call before you haul. Most recent posted practice ran 9 am–3 pm.
places.day: Most recent posted practice: amateur supercross track $40, outdoor track $40, or $60 for both. Prices are set per practice day.
places.source_title: WW Ranch Motocross Park: the track's own website

places.hours: No fixed schedule posted. The track asks riders to call before hauling: (386) 437-7191 for track conditions.
rules: Full-size, intermediate and peewee/pit bike tracks
places.source_title: Pax Trax Motocross Park: the track's own website

places.hours: Whole-track rental, 10 am–4 pm, any day of the week by booking.
places.day: Track rental from $499 plus tax for up to 10 riders, $50 for each extra rider. The track's FAQ page shows $599 plus tax: confirm the rate when you book.
places.how: Book the whole track in advance; it is yours alone for the day. No walk-in practice.
rules: Main track and a separate beginner track
Dirt bikes and quads allowed; ask before bringing a side-by-side
places.source_title: Dan Woodley Racing: the track's own website

places.day: Riding $50 a day per rider, listed with the ride-and-stay packages.
places.how: No membership needed to stay. Day visitors should contact the facility first.
rules: Motocross, sand and pit bike tracks
places.source_title: Decker Training Facility at County Line MX: the track's own website

places.hours: The motocross track runs on select Saturdays only. The park around it is open Friday to Monday: 8 am–7 pm June to September, 8 am–5 pm October to May.
places.day: Park entrance fee only: adults (16–64) $15, children 7–15 $5, 6 and under free, seniors 65+ $10, military $10.
places.how: Book the Bone Yard ahead through the county reservation system and show the reservation and receipt at the gate. A waiver is needed once a year.
rules: Motorcycles only on the Bone Yard: no ATVs or side-by-sides
Spark arrester and working muffler required; 96 dB sound limit
Protective gear required on the track
Under 18 needs a parent or guardian present
Follow the flag marshals and the entry and exit directions
places.source_title: Bone Yard Motocross Track: Polk County parks page

places.hours: Event days only. No regular public practice hours are posted.
places.how: Riding is through event registration with the promoter.
places.source_title: Gatorback Cycle Park: the promoter's own website

places.hours: Event only: the track is built for the race and removed afterwards. The next Daytona Supercross is March 6, 2027.
places.how: Spectators need a ticket. Amateur riders enter through the amateur supercross event registration.
places.address: 1801 W International Speedway Blvd, Daytona Beach, FL 32114
places.source_title: Daytona Supercross: the speedway's own website

places.how: The only schedule and prices we can find are on the old track page from 2020, under earlier management. Call before you haul.
